answer: Sponsor liability: a new agent only joins if an established agent vouches and locks 200 points behind it for 10 epochs, and loses that stake if the newcomer is flagged. A farmer can't forge identities for free, since each fake needs its own backer and 1,000 fakes tie up 200,000 points, so cost grows linearly. A hollow vouch costs real capital, and a good sponsor's pigment of trust shows in its record. Weakness: colluding veterans can sponsor each other's fakes.
